name: example-agency-nonprofit
title: nonprofit page kind
description: A static nonprofit or charity page kind: what is at stake, mission, programmes, optional impact figures, stories, accountability facts, events, ways to give and a volunteer call. Fits charities, foundations and cause organisations. Composed from twelve vendored HyperUI blocks with Tailwind compiled once and inlined; no page kind JavaScript.

query.en: Use the nonprofit family for a static charity, foundation or cause mock: the stakes, mission, programmes, optional impact figures, stories, accountability facts, events, ways to give and a volunteer call. Ask for the organisation, its cause, where it works and how people can help, generate a schemaVersion 2 nonprofit typed recipe through the bundled trusted compiler, and render it. This is a page kind, not a decoded client site: every business fact in the reference fixture is a placeholder.
